request: Sixty-sixth build (incremental on the sixty-fifth, run 43585381968). patches-in-sync found about 264 upstream BUILD.gn and README.chromium files in the vendored tree that differ from upstream in formatting alone: gnrt formats with the gn on PATH and only warns when that fails, and depot_tools' gn wrapper fails on CI before gclient has bootstrapped depot_tools. vendor-rust-crates.sh now gives gnrt the checkout's own gn, fails on any unformatted BUILD.gn, and drops overlay copies the checkout has as upstream. This build prints what that changes (vendor_dump) to commit it. No tests, no spoken suite.
